definitions.full: H7662. shebaq [ שְׁבַק ] verb leave, let alone ( שְׁבַק ᵑ7 , Syriac ; compare Biblical Hebrew, p. 990); — Pe`al Infinitive לְמִשְׁבַּק Dan 4:23 leave roots, so Imperative masculine plural שְׁבֻ֫קוּ 4:12 ; 4:20 (both with ב location); Ezra 6:7 let alone , with ל accusative of thing. Hithpe`el Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּשְׁתְּבִק Dan 2:44 be left (of kingdom, + ל of a people).
